task.description: WF-03 Step 0.5: search docs/issues/*.yaml for a status: resolved entry whose description mentions matching symptoms (web/src/api/identity.ts calling a non-existent /api/v1/... path instead of the real /api/v1/identity/... router mount) to ISS-0782 (usersApi/rolesApi 404s against the running backend, breaking the Users admin screen).
acceptance_criteria: grep docs/issues/*.yaml for identity.ts / usersApi / rolesApi / groupsApi / /admin/groups / /admin/roles / /admin/users mentions

for each hit, determine whether it is the same symptom class (same root cause recurring, i.e. a fix that already shipped for this exact file/root-cause and didn't hold) or a related-but-distinct issue

state in result.summary whether a prior RESOLVED match was found, and if so, whether this is a recurrence requiring a severity bump; also note any related OPEN issues even though they don't independently trigger a recurrence bump

result.summary:
Searched docs/issues/*.yaml for 'identity.ts|usersApi|rolesApi|groupsApi|tokensApi' -- 4 hits: ISS-0782 (this issue), ISS-0736 (resolved), ISS-0765 (open), ISS-0764 (open, unrelated -- TenantStatus's PLATFORM_ADMIN exemption reading conn.assigns.auth_context.roles raw, no identity.ts involvement, a false-positive keyword hit on 'roles').

ISS-0736 (status: resolved, resolved_in_run WF03-ISS0736-20260921) is NOT a symptom match for ISS-0782 itself -- its own root cause was OIDC live-revocation enforcement (REQ-378) -- but its resolution incidentally corrected ONE call site in this exact file for the exact same underlying defect CLASS: web/src/api/identity.ts's groupsApi.removeMembers was calling a nonexistent 'DELETE /api/v1/admin/groups/:id/members' (no /admin/groups mount anywhere in lib/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline.ex) and was corrected to the real router-backed 'DELETE /api/v1/identity/groups/:id/members/:user_id', with regression coverage added at web/src/api/__tests__/identity.removeMembers.test.ts. CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR on that same run (WF03-ISS0736-20260921) flagged as an out-of-scope finding that every OTHER groupsApi call (addMembers/.list/.get/.update/.delete/.members) still shares the identical broken /api/v1/admin/groups/... prefix -- that finding was filed separately as ISS-0765 (status: open, MAJOR, unresolved as of this run) rather than fixed in-scope of REQ-378.

CONCLUSION: no prior RESOLVED entry addresses ISS-0782's own affected call sites (usersApi.list/get/create/update and rolesApi.list, per web/src/pages/admin/UsersPage.tsx + UserDetailPage.tsx -- see Step 1 handoff) -- this is not a recurrence of an already-fixed root cause, so no severity bump on that basis. However this IS the third distinct filed occurrence of the SAME defect class in the SAME file (identity.ts hardcoding a nonexistent /api/v1/admin/... or bare /api/v1/... prefix instead of the real /api/v1/identity/... router mount): ISS-0736 fixed one call site (removeMembers), ISS-0765 (still open) covers the rest of groupsApi, and this issue (ISS-0782) covers usersApi + rolesApi. web/src/api/identity.ts has never received one comprehensive audit against the real router table -- each fix so far has been reactive and single-call-site/single-object scoped. Noting this pattern for CODE-DESIGNER and ORCH: worth a follow-up recommendation (not expanding THIS issue's scope) that identity.ts's remaining objects (tokensApi, and the still-unrouted usersApi.delete/.resetPassword and rolesApi.get/.update/.delete/.grantPermission/.revokePermission, none of which have a matching backend route at all, routed or not) get one full audit pass rather than discovering the rest piecemeal via UAT. Severity stays at ISS-0782's filed MAJOR; this run does not overlap ISS-0765's already-open scope (groupsApi) except incidentally where UserDetailPage.tsx also calls groupsApi.list -- flagged explicitly in the Step 1 handoff for CODE-DESIGNER to decide whether to include that one shared call site here or defer to ISS-0765.
